title: Registered pipeline catalog, start and run timeline controls
goal: Understand actual registered pipeline controls and saved statuses while preserving current authority, exact approval, budget and uncertain-outcome boundaries.
prerequisites: Authenticated workspace for pages; session start requires same-origin/currentsessionuser/actions:apply. Visible button does not establish role or provider readiness.
Catalog Start sends emptybody: required coding repository/instruction metadata must come from an existing appropriate task workflow; no new input capability invented.
Internal local source snapshot only; no live runtime/provider/AI/DB/account/configuration checked.
permissions: Start/write/decision authorization belongs to existing server checks, not article/control labels. API-key v1 scopes are separate from cookie UI.
Exact coding stage artifact approval and quorum do not establish distinct humans or universal provider authorization; original requester/current role and per-provider write guards remain.
No cap/model/policy changes, provider credentials, native actions or automatic retry permission is granted.

steps.expectedState: Registry cards and last20runs/counts are saved presentation; caught read failures can look empty, not proof of absent runs.

steps.instruction: Use Back to Workforce or open an existing recent run.
steps.expectedState: Navigation only; no role/provider permission granted.

steps.instruction: Start only through an intended authorized workflow with its prerequisites.
steps.expectedState: Run pipeline sends emptybody/cookiePOST, Starting disables and returnedrunId redirects. No repo/instruction/cap/model fields or originalnonce control; errors reenable but lost acknowledgement may follow committed start.

steps.instruction: Inspect exact run summary and ordered stage timeline.
steps.expectedState: Queued/running/succeeded/failed/skipped/awaitingapproval are saved state; run success, duration/dryrun copy and static coding test review are not provider/test/deployment acceptance.

steps.instruction: Follow stage approval ID to the separate approval workflow when present.
steps.expectedState: Link itself does not vote/execute. Exactartifact review/current role/tenant/principal/quorum remain server guards; terminal quorum may autoresume, best-effort.

steps.instruction: Keep stage approval, generic approval execution and coding PR authority distinct.
steps.expectedState: Originalrequester/currentapply/access/exactartifact/oneattemptprovider guards still apply; APIkey votes are machine principals, not twohumanreview proof; no automerge.
No automatic capraise/modelchange/holdreduction/retry; unresolvedholds full exposure, not zero or expiredrefund.

steps.instruction: After unknown acknowledgement inspect existing run/approval/history deliberately.
steps.expectedState: No documented detail Retry/Resume/Cancel action, no originalstartlookup or automaticresend. Provider unknown does not authorize reset/replay.

steps.instruction: Treat global-admin telemetry as separate cost projection.
steps.expectedState: Configured-admin-only endpoint, nottenant UI; pending/unknown/zero is not finalinvoice or budgetauthority; localnewsource notlive acceptance.

expectedOutcome: Identify the five direct control families, ordinary saved-status next steps and safe refusal/uncertainty interpretation without claiming generic pipeline/provider success.
limitations: Finite catalog/run controls, not full nested approval/codingtask/provider/API/admin/native coverage.
Empty catalog/counts can be caught backend read failures; no explicit UI error distinction or polling/retry control is invented.
Current1000fixedhold may refuse500defaultcap; usefulquotes/defaultcompletion unfinished, no automatic allowance/model/estimate bypass.
Globaladmin telemetry local pending/unknown/final projection is not tenant UI, credit authority or provider invoice verification.
recovery: For lost start response inspect existing recent history before considering a new authorized action; button has no persisted idempotency key/originallookup and reenabled is not rollback proof.
For stage approval uncertainty inspect saved approval and run. Duplicate vote or terminalapproval is not a resume repair; no run-detail Retry/Resume/Cancel control exists.
For role/metadata/connection/executor/artifact/budget refusal preserve prerequisite and use responsible existing workflow/admin review; never automatically raise cap/change model/replay.
Dispatchedunknown/pending calls retain full exposure; missingusage/timeout/lostproviderwrite is not refund/expiryrelease/secondattempt.
Exact provider approval and requester execution boundaries must be reviewed in the relevant existing action workflow; sourceguide or generic stage success cannot substitute.
